text: If you have not taken my courses and do not understand what some “third chakra” has to do with it, I recommend that you combine taking this intensive with a workshop or course in which I smoothly lead you to an understanding of what we are doing here. It is important not simply to “believe” me, but to open understanding within yourself through personal experience - both on the yoga mat and in life. Then the practices begin to work much deeper. Otherwise we get physical education - since this is the basic understanding (experience) of yoga that everyone has.
